verdict.rationale: Google Authenticator is a consumer OTP app. A buyer could fairly ask whether such a product offers official SDKs, so the axis applies. The pack shows open-source one-time passcode generator implementations and a PAM module (gh-1, gh-2, gh-3), but these are reference code and a system authentication module, not a documented SDK that developers build applications against. None of the support-doc material describes any SDK or developer API, so this is at most adjacent building-block material.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
